_comment: Central switches for the DeepSeek PR review. enabled=false holds every caller; auto=false makes reviews mention-only. Flip a value and commit to main; callers that pin the reusable workflow by SHA still respect this file. A failed fetch holds reviews (fail closed). The poll block drives deepseek-poll-review.yml: it reviews PRs in poll.repos through the GitHub API (no workflow in the target repo); enabled/auto apply to it too.
